# NewtonArticulationRootAPI (self-collision fallback)

Newton self-collision switch, read on every articulation root when PhysxArticulationAPI carries no enabledSelfCollisions.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable), [`PhysicsJoint`](glossary.md#physicsjoint)
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysicsArticulationRootAPI`](PhysicsArticulationRootAPI.md)
- **No [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns) gate:** the consumer reads these columns whenever they exist on the [prim](glossary.md#prim), applied or not. Listing the API is still what the producer does and what the builders write.

## What USD population writes

Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the [ovphysx](glossary.md#ovphysx) Newton schema notes).

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `newton:selfCollisionEnabled` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | true | true, unless PhysxArticulationAPI physxArticulation:enabledSelfCollisions is present. |

## Notes

- The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonArticulationRootAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonArticulationRootAPI makes the cache bypass.
- Newton's schema makes PhysicsArticulationRootAPI built-ins of this API, and USD population lists built-ins among a prim's applied schemas. The builder writes only what the caller applies, so it requires them on the same prim instead of writing a prim the walker would not recognize.
